notes.title: 📢 NOCTUARY MAJOR UPDATE! CONSOLE VERSION and FREE DLC OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Dear Illuminators,Following the free release of the digital artbook, Noctuary is once again bringing a rich and significant free update patch!Packed with brand-new features—including the free DLC, full voiceover for the main story (Japanese), gameplay optimizations, and bug fixes—this update invites you to return to Inlixaland for an all-new adventure!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956933/0cec5f81d0a35aeeec98bb2f278e273a892d2524.png"]
⏰ Update Time
July 30th
🎁Update Highlights🌸I. Noctuary Free DLC: New Journey
Immerse in New Stories: Experience 6 exciting chapters consisting of 17 episodes!

Thrilling Mysteries & Adventures:

Krosa Nonet from another continent, brings the famed local delicacy--‘Glase’!

What led to the Crystal Family’s sudden downfall? What secrets lie in their past?

The enigmatic "Light Knight" is revealed as her partner?!

... ...

All unfolds in Noctuary Free DLC: New Journey!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956933/b32d954ddabc9418cb0f7a1309db3867f7465c48.gif"]

 

 \[Krosa Nonet] 🥊

Steam Fists: "Boom, boom, boom!"

Glase: "Gulp, gulp, gulp!"

Will to live: "I got it alllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllll!"

Even in the Inlixaland, I have my own way of fighting!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956933/1a6c211f3e26bc000ce9f224748a78b0ec451c9f.gif"]

 

 \[Lura Graves] 🌿

Mark → Entangle → Eliminate

Nature and darkness grant her symbiotic control over the earth.

Darkritters... Not just foes...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956933/1f50f8b1e4eb98636d941f547868efc6acb911b0.gif"]



  \[Kira Crimson] ⚡

Swift Precision, One-Shot Kills

Like crimson lightning,

She dances the dance of death in the dark.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956933/59002a3bcc84d623a7c4329e648976fac24c1f41.gif"]



How to Access the DLC:

Launch Noctuary after updating.

Find the "Story Archive" entry at the bottom-left of the Quest interface.

Unlock Condition: To avoid spoilers, the first DLC story unlocks after completing Chapter 4's quest 'Revived Memories'. Subsequent stories unlock sequentially.


🎧II. Major Upgrade: Full Main Story Voice Acting!
Fancia Dream CV: Nazuka Kaori

Alina Nightsong CV: Ueda Kana

Click @异美工作室 for reveals of other voice actors!


⚙️III. Gameplay Optimizations – Smoother Experience!
✂️Dialogue Skip: During AVG, hold U to skip dialogue and view a summary.

🏳️Battle Skip: After losing a battle, skip it via the prompt.

🎭Hide Dialogue Box: Press H anytime during AVG segments to hide the text box and focus on visuals.


🐞 IV. Bug Fixes & Optimizations
Gameplay:

\[Fix] Fixed partial controller compatibility issues.

\[Fix] Fixed the issue where Fancia's bow stance combos would reset after dodging.

\[Fix] Fixed characters forcibly completing idle animations before switching protagonists.

\[Fix] Corrected multiple text display/translation errors.

\[Optimization] Optimized display support for non-standard aspect ratios.

Story:

\[Fix] Fixed conflicting timeline records between Alina and Intimia regarding the Arboranger Squad leader.

\[Fix] Corrected unlock conditions for some character profiles.


 🎮V. Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5 Version OUT!


Embark on a narrative-driven action RPG through Inlixaland, a fairy-tale realm teeming with magical creatures, mysterious secrets, and dangerous foes known as the Darkritters ⚔️

The console debut of Noctuary introduces hours of brand-new content, a completely reworked English translation, and a suite of new settings that allow players to tailor their adventure.! 👇

Launch Trailer:

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/nxKI6X7q6vc?si=1iw0g39a3Lqn4jbU"][/dynamiclink]Console Store Links:

https://www.gamesource-ent.com/detail/771    Asia area

 https://serenityforge.com/games/noctuary       Other areas in the world



Nintendo Switch: https://ec.nintendo.com/HK/zh/titles/70010000096950

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012287

XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/noctuary/9ntgknvt75n0
[hr][/hr]
The gateway to new tales is open! Wield your Illumiarms and dive into Noctuary for an unforgettable adventure!

notes.title: Noctuary Trading Cards & Points Shop Items Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Illuminators,

The exclusive Trading Cards & Points Shop Items for Noctuary will officially launch, accompanied by a historic low-price sale!
Come claim your community items and decorate your profile now!

This set of Noctuary exclusive community items includes:
 1 Badge set, 9 Trading Cards, 4 Profile Backgrounds, and 8 Emoticons!

- **Trading Cards**:  You can play a participating game to get trading cards. Half the card set is received during gameplay (based on playtime in the game), the other half is earned through collecting (trading with or buying from other users through Steam and the Steam Community Market).
- **Crafting Badges**: A full set of cards can be crafted into a game badge that can be prominently displayed on the profile and the mini profile (seen when hovering on a user's avatar.)
- **Get Rewards**: During badge crafting users receive random rewards from a set of game related items including emoticons, profile backgrounds, and coupons.

What are you waiting for? Head to Inlixaland and claim your exclusive Illuminators cards now!

notes.title: Noctuary will join the Anime Game Festival!
notes.content:

We have prepared special discounts for the event in advance!
